## Scope check

Before proposing, please check this against the product spec's explicit non-goals: **AI
proctoring** (facial recognition, eye tracking), **webcam identity verification**, **automatic
LLM essay grading**, **mobile-native apps**, and **multi-school SaaS** are all out of scope for
this project by design, not by oversight — a proposal in one of these areas will likely be
declined regardless of how well it's specified.
